purpose: A person record's Address section: reads the addresses, shows them as a card group, and saves, changes and removes them in the holder's vault.
namedChanges: `ownerHome` is not taken (GilbApp B3: the section was read-only with one line when the address was written as the vault owner's own). The held card has no owner-home address. `locked` and the owner-home line go with it; `editMode` and `addInPlace` drop `!ownerHome`.
What the read came to is handed to the card (F1-F4): `readState` and `canAdd`. New optional prop `vaultName`, for "Not every address in <name> was read."
No add while the vault was never read (F3): `canAdd` is false while the status is `failed` and no read of this vault has answered. GilbApp had no failed state.
